title: Empowering States' Rights To Protect Consumers Act of 2013
short_title: Empowering States' Rights To Protect Consumers Act of 2013

committees.name: Banking, Housing, and Urban Affairs Committee

actions.text: Sponsor introductory remarks on measure. (CR S5268-5269)
Read twice and referred to the Committee on Banking, Housing, and Urban Affairs.

latest_action.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Banking, Housing, and Urban Affairs.

summaries.text: Empowering States' Rights To Protect Consumers Act of 2013 - Amends the Truth In Lending Act to limit the annual percentage rate (APR) applicable to any consumer credit transaction (other than a residential mortgage transaction), including any associated fees, to the maximum rate permitted by the laws of the state in which the consumer resides.
